_notes: plan: unified to «тариф» in every student/mobile string of this job (cur mixed «жоспар», «қолдау жоспары», «тариф»). «жоспар» collides with «оқу жоспары» (study plan); marketing/common/agency kk already say «тариф».

team identity (V22): student-facing «кеңесшіңіз / тексерушіңіз» replaced by «Hangyul командасы» (English «Hangyul team») and «Hangyul Univ командасы» (English «Hangyul Univ team»); «Hangyul Univ тобы» inside the job changed to «командасы». About 59 strings in packages/i18n/locales/kk/student.json outside this job still say «Hangyul Univ тобы» — owner to decide on a global rename. Staff-facing agency/university strings keep «кеңесші» where the English says counselor.
passport: unified to the official «төлқұжат» (cur mixed «паспорт»); «паспорт» remains in a few strings outside this job.

personal statement = «мотивациялық хат» (established in common/marketing kk); «editing» rendered «редакциялау», not «түзету» (correction), so the student-does-the-writing promise is kept. Mock interview = «сынақ сұхбат» (common kk). Priority response = «Бірінші кезекте жауап» (common kk).
applicant (university console) rendered «талапкер», the usual Kazakhstani admissions word; university.json has one «үміткер» (v25.head.decide) outside this job — owner may want to align it.
Dates/amounts after a placeholder cannot take a Kazakh case suffix safely, so «by {{date}}» is «{{date}} күніне дейін» and budget ranges are «Ең көбі {{amount}}» / «{{amount}} және одан көп».
mobile:login.networkError: the current Kazakh carried developer-only emulator instructions; replaced with the glossary «can't be reached» wording.
student:v17.gate.named keeps the frame «Тариф {{what}} қамтиды» so the existing accusative gate.what.* values still read as one sentence.
Kazakh has no plural inflection on counted nouns, so _one/_other forms are identical and always carry {{count}}.

Not changed, for the owner: «кеңес» is kept for consultation (bundle-wide); «консультация» would be clearer for a scheduled session in Kazakhstan but changing it is a global decision. Localized examples (Әл-Фараби атындағы ҚазҰУ, қазақстандық компаниялар) were left as they are.
